episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: While seeking answers about his parents, Shadow reveals a dark truth linked to his long-time benefactor, Servet, who employs him as his right-hand man.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Muhtar opens up his home to Shadow. Shadow offers Mümtaz a deal in exchange for protection from Servet, but his scheme backfires.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Shadow attempts to flee the country, Servet confronts Mümtaz about the weapons and a flashback jogs Shadow's memory of a loved one's death.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Shadow warns Muhtar about Mesut's designs on the neighborhood. A heartbroken Civan becomes caught between Mesut and Shadow.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Underground boss Azrail approaches Shadow about a missing package. Özlem knocks on Mesut's door. Servet struggles with guilt.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Muhtar and Dilara face the risk of losing their pastry shop. Özlem helps Mesut cover his tracks after their plan runs amok.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: Civan crosses paths with Servet and makes a business proposal. Yakup leads a figure from Adem's past to Shadow's doorstep.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: A gift leads Yakup to suspect Shadow's identity, Civan serves Mesut his comeuppance and Servet reveals to Shadow a shocking truth.
